content.text: Main Content Spirited Belonging Since our earliest years, TCU has embraced a rich tradition of athletic excellence. TCU has won 25 Big 12 championships since joining the league in 2012 Sports TCU is proud to compete at the highest level of NCAA Division I sports as a member of the Big 12 Conference.
